name: Achuth V P
title: Application Security Professional
summary: Application security professional with experience in manual and automated security assessments across the SDLC—secure design review, threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing in Java, Python, and JavaScript stacks. Builds security automation to identify and mitigate issues at scale and partners with engineering on secure development. Background in first-party security research with 15+ critical findings, five CVEs, and Google Hall of Fame recognition.

highlights: Conduct application security reviews and API assessments for production services, partnering with engineering on remediation and secure development practices.
Build and integrate security automation into CI and development workflows.
Support org-wide controls to reduce secrets and credential exposure risk.
Participate in threat modeling and security design reviews for high-risk product flows.
Contribute to software supply chain and pipeline security initiatives.
Conducted first-party and third-party application security research, disclosing 12+ critical vulnerabilities (RCE, LFI, XSS, CSRF) and reducing exploitable attack surface in widely deployed software.
Led 20+ application security assessments (manual and tool-assisted) across fintech, healthcare, and SaaS, averaging 30+ findings per engagement and supporting secure SDLC and compliance goals.
Built 7+ Python/Bash security automation tools for web and API testing, cutting manual assessment effort by 60% and enabling repeatable security testing at scale.
Supported network and application penetration testing and vulnerability remediation for enterprise client environments.
Authored internal exploit documentation and contributed to cybersecurity blogs with 1,000+ readers.
